page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening) with a single main text column; a narrow strip of the facing left page at the left edge shows only fragments of margin text, which are cut off and not legible enough to transcribe. Running head "PARSI I." at top with page number "55" at top right. Body text in one column with fractions and worked calculation display in the middle; signature "D 4" and catchword "Vte" at the foot.

main_text.p: tarum partium nomina diuiso, factos à quotis per datos numeratores, pro quæ-sitarū partiū numeratoribus usurpat.

Magni usus res est, partes facere cognomines, atque proportionales in minimis inter se terminis, hoc est, ex heterogeneis, quasi homogeneas facere. Sint igitur 3/4 & 5/6 cognomines faciendæ: Minimum igitur à nomimbus diuiduum 12, per 4 & 6, datarum partium nomina diuido, perque quotos 3 & 2 datos numeratores 3 & 5 multiplico, facti 9 & 10 quæsitarum partiū numeratores, minimus autem à nomimbus diuiduus, scilicet 12, commune nomen erit. Exemplum sic est:
Sunt igitur in primo exemplo 9/12 & 10/12 partes cognomines, similiterque inter se minimæ, datis proportionales.

page.notes: Fractions and calculation display are set in small type and reconstructed approximately; the numerals in the display are uncertain. Facing left page shows only cropped margin fragments, not transcribed.
